title: Scripts
description: Commands saved on this service. Run them by hand, on a schedule, through the API or after each deployment.

run.title: Run
run.truncated: It printed more than is kept: this is the end of it, up to {{count}} characters.
run.incomplete: This output is not complete: the note above says why.

empty.title: No scripts yet
empty.description: Saved scripts appear next to Sh and Bash in the console, and can run by themselves.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Every run of this service's scripts, with who or what started it and how it ended.

runNote.not_started: The panel restarted before this run could start.
runNote.no_running_task: The service had no running task to run this script in.
runNote.script_deleted: This script was deleted before the run could start.
runNote.start_failed: Docker could not start this script: {{message}}
runNote.connection_lost: The panel lost its connection to this process. Output after that moment was not captured.
runNote.time_limit: It was still running at its limit of {{seconds}} seconds, so the panel ended it.
runNote.end_unconfirmed: The panel told this process to end, but could not confirm that it did.
runNote.panel_restarted: The panel restarted as this run was starting. Anything that had started was ended, and what it did is not known.
runNote.panel_restarted_running: The panel restarted during this run. The process is still running: output since the restart is not being captured.
runNote.panel_restarted_finished: The panel restarted during this run. It ended while the panel was not watching, with the exit code Docker reported. Output after the restart was not captured.
runNote.panel_restarted_unknown: The panel restarted during this run and Docker no longer knows this process. How it ended is not known, and output after the restart was not captured.
runNote.console_output: Run from the console: its output went to the terminal and was not kept.
runNote.console_closed: Run from the console: the session was closed while it was running.
runNote.skipped_overlap: Not started: the previous run of this script was still in progress.

dialog.timeZoneHint: The schedule follows this zone, daylight saving included.
dialog.runAfterDeployHint: Starts once a deployment has succeeded. If it fails, the deployment still stands.
dialog.nameHint: The button's label in the console.
dialog.scheduleHint: A common schedule, or a cron line below.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this script?
deleteDialog.description: {{name}} will no longer be offered in the console, and its schedule stops. Its past runs stay listed.
